novel.justification: The exclusive stratum contains observed laws for which every compatible compact-box representation has the same single control-row collision while the other three terminal rows remain distinct. Such pooling is natural when latent groups share one next-state probability but differ elsewhere. Exclusivity makes the named stratum a complete causal model rather than a selected representation and, by compactness of the global fiber, keeps its noncollided gaps bounded away from zero at each law.
